children: slipped 0.8% in Monday's trading after saying it

30% of its 9.9% stake in American Savings Bank for $29.5M as part of ASB's initial public offering, which the company said will strengthen its financial position and reduce future capital raises required for remaining Maui wildfire settlement payments.
said it sold ~2M shares, resulting in $29.5M in net proceeds, with an underwriters option to purchase up to nearly 294K additional shares, which would result in an additional $4.4M in net proceeds.
Based on ASB's closing share price of $17.57 as of September 18, Hawaiian Electric's
remaining 6.4% stake in ASB is valued at $73.5M.
The company said it will consider plans to monetize its remaining shares following the expiration of a 180-day lockup period, subject to market conditions and other relevant considerations.
ASB was a wholly-owned subsidiary of Hawaiian Electric
before the sale of 90.1% of ASB in December 2024; ASB began trading on the New York Stock Exchange following its IPO on September 16.
